spec_match.rationale: Reproduces the explainer's Example 2 (carousel wedged by scrollIntoView) as a controlled A/B: identical content under scroll hidden vs scroll clip, with the contract that a clipped axis cannot move from 0.

interactive.rationale: One button runs the same real scrollIntoView on both carousels; reset restores; readouts measure the real scrollTop of each.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the A/B with real measurements; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: On legacy engines both carousels wedge and the page says so explicitly (the bug being fixed), never claiming the clip side held when it didn't.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5067363861004288; page links the original jsbin.

conformance.rationale: The suite's clipped-axis-script-immovable assertion (with its hidden-still-movable control) is this page's mechanism as a self-contained check.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: after the call both carousels measured 54px (legacy behavior honestly reported); reset returned both to 0; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: saxis-apis-compared asserts the expected relationship per engine state.

design_system.rationale: Wedged/held readouts in rose/emerald on stone (AA); target item inverts bg and color; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Carousels are labelled focusable regions; readouts are aria-live with textual state; buttons native.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Duo grid collapses under 720px; strips pan inside their own boxes; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Capture the diverging A/B on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a true-clip engine the same click should leave the clip carousel at 0 while the hidden one wedges — capture that run to complete the comparison evidence.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Carousels need accessible names and keyboard reachability.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both carousels are role=region with aria-labels and tabindex=0.

guidanceConsulted.query: two card comparison grid mobile collapse
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Side-by-side comparisons collapse to stacked cards on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Duo grid is 1-column under 720px; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the A/B runs the real scrollIntoView, measures both scrollTops (54px/54px on legacy Chromium 141, honestly narrated), and resets cleanly. The diverging measurement on a true-clip engine is the open question.
